sutta: Nagas. 30.3 Savatthi, monk asked the Buddha, "Venerable sir, what is the cause and reason that why someone here with the breakup of the body after death is reborn in the company of egg-born Supannas?" And the Buddha said, "Here monk, someone acts ambivalently in body, speech, and mind. He has heard egg-born Supannas are long-lived, beautiful, and abound in happiness. He thinks, 'Oh, with the breakup of the body after death, may I be reborn in the company of egg-born Supannas.' And with the breakup of the body after death, he is reborn in the company of egg-born Supannas. This monk is the cause and reason why someone here with the breakup of the body after death is reborn in the company of egg-born Supannas." Is the end of the Sutta. So, this one is similar to the Nagasa. A person he has good and bad karma. And he's always thinking of these Garudas and hoping to be reborn as these egg-born Garudas. So, that's why he's reborn then. So, what we think is something dangerous and sometimes we keep we like something and we keep thinking about something and then we create the affinity. And so similarly for the other three types of Supannasa, the womb-born, moisture-born, and spontaneously born also are similar. And then 30.7. And the monk asked the Buddha again, "Venerable sir, what is the cause and reason why someone here with the breakup of the body after death is reborn in the company of egg-born Supannas?" And the Buddha said, "Here, monk, someone acts ambivalently in body, speech, and mind. He has heard egg-born Supannas are long-lived, beautiful, and abound in happiness. He thinks, 'Oh, with the breakup of the body death, may I be reborn in the company of egg-born Supannas.' So, he gives food, he gives drink, he gives clothing, he gives vehicles, he gives garlands, he gives fragrance, he gives unguents, he gives beds, he gives dwellings, he gives land, etc. Then with the breakup of the body after death, he is reborn in the company of egg-born Supannas. This, monk, is the cause and reason why someone here with the breakup of the body after death is reborn in the company of egg-born Supannas."
